name: Disneyland Little Red Wagon Hand-Dipped Corn Dog & Applesauce/Chips
brandOrRestaurant: Little Red Wagon & Stage Door Café (Main Street / Frontierland · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Uses finely milled cornmeal/wheat batter with zero whole corn kernels around an all-beef/pork frankfurter; blot the outer fried batter or peel half off if sensitive to fryer oil.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with a small bag of chips or applesauce (if choosing sliced apples, peel or skip the tough red apple skins) and blot excess fryer oil with a napkin.
watchOuts: Deep-fried batter is high in oil and sodium—save for steady days or peel away part of the thick batter
